_comment: A saved scan's persisted JSON in the shape written by PetScans 1.4.3 and earlier.
Captured before the decoder hardening of 2026-07-30. This file must NEVER be
edited to accommodate a schema change — its whole purpose is to prove that a
scan saved by a shipped build still decodes correctly after one. If a change
breaks it, the change breaks History on every device that has these rows.
Note what is absent: matchConfidence, scoresAreMissing, and any processing
